day_shape: 66 items: reports of a 60-day US-Iran deal to reopen Hormuz with Iran considering surrendering enriched uranium, Trump assurances to Netanyahu on dismantling enrichment, fresh IDF strikes and evacuation warnings across south Lebanon, and Iran's first wartime espionage execution.

threads.label: US-Iran deal contours and Israeli reaction
threads.summary: Reports said a US-Iran arrangement would reopen the Strait of Hormuz for 60 days with Tehran discussing relinquishing enriched uranium, while Netanyahu said Trump assured him any final deal must dismantle enrichment. Rubio said Trump 'shouldn't be questioned' on the 60-day ceasefire, and a diplomatic source said Washington is updating Israel on MOU negotiations.

threads.label: IDF strikes and warnings in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF Arabic spokesperson issued urgent evacuation warnings for over a dozen southern Lebanese towns including Kafrsir, Mishgareh and Deir al-Zahrani, citing Hezbollah ceasefire breaches. The IDF said four Hezbollah operatives were killed entering an infrastructure site and that troops dismantled a 100-metre tunnel with four hideout rooms in Mount Dov.

threads.label: Drone downed over Hormozgan
threads.summary: Defa Press said Iran's integrated air defence network destroyed an Israeli-made Orbiter drone attempting to penetrate Hormozgan province's airspace, with wreckage recovered. The Jerusalem Post separately reported the Iranian army downed an Israeli-made drone in Hormozgan.

threads.label: Ramadan War 40th anniversary commemorations
threads.summary: Iranian state and IRGC-affiliated outlets covered the fortieth anniversary commemoration of the 'Imposed Ramadan War' martyrs at Imam Khomeini's prayer ground, with messages from military commanders including Admiral Siayari, General Rezaei and General Abdollahi. Defa Press and IRIB carried statements asserting Iran's victory, 'finger on the trigger' posture, and a 'new model of war.'

threads.label: Iran diplomacy and proxy messaging
threads.summary: IRIB said deputy FM Gharibabadi conveyed FM Araghchi's message to Oman's foreign minister on US-Iran talks with Pakistani mediation, while the Jerusalem Post reported Araghchi told Hezbollah's Qassem that Iran would continue backing regional proxies. President Pezeshkian said no decision is taken without the Supreme Leader's permission.

threads.label: Iran internal security and sanctions evasion
threads.summary: The Times of Israel reported Iran executed its first man accused of espionage during the current war with the US and Israel, and detailed a Zanjani-linked network said to have moved over $1.7 billion via Binance from Chinese clients to wallets financing Iranian proxies. A separate report cited a 'pledge' by al-Saadi to kill Ivanka Trump in retaliation for Soleimani's 2020 killing.

threads.label: Regime claims of war's external costs
threads.summary: IRIB cited Bloomberg saying Qatar Airways will cancel bonuses for nearly 60,000 employees due to the Iran war, with the carrier running below 60 per cent of normal schedule. It also cited Al-Mayadeen on leaked Australian energy documents examining petrol rationing scenarios attributed to the Iran war.

events.title_en: Regulations for organising civilian drones approved
events.summary_en: Regulations for organising civilian drones approved. In a Cabinet session, the executive regulations of the law on organising remotely piloted aircraft (drones) for civilian use were approved. In accordance with these regulations, the list of types of drones based on the possibility of monitoring, surveillance, tracking and technical interception by the Ministry of Defence will be approved by the working group referred to in Article 3 of the law on organising civilian remotely piloted aircraft. The regulations addressed matters such as design, manufacture and production; systems, specialised portals and permits; tariffs; exports and imports; maintenance, operation and supervision; and general obligations, restrictions and prohibitions related to civilian drones.

events.title_en: Newsweek: With intense anger of American farmers, Trump's popularity among rural residents has fallen
events.summary_en: Newsweek: With intense anger of American farmers, Trump's popularity among rural residents has fallen. The rate of satisfaction with Trump's performance in this sector, which is considered his traditional voting base, was negative for the first time since 2025. According to the latest Fox News poll, the net satisfaction rate with Trump's performance among rural voters fell by 34 points from positive 20 per cent to negative 14 per cent. According to this poll, a total of 71 per cent of all eligible voters and 70 per cent of rural residents expressed dissatisfaction with Trump's economic policies. The issue of inflation, with 76 per cent public dissatisfaction, was assessed as the weakest point of his administration's performance.

events.title_en: Pezeshkian: No decision in the country is taken without the leadership's permission
events.summary_en: Pezeshkian: No decision in the country is taken without the leadership's permission. The President said: No decision in the country will be made outside the framework of the Supreme National Security Council and without the permission of the esteemed leader. What has ensured the preservation and stability of the country at critical junctures has been the solidarity and harmony of the people and the pillars of the system. Jihad only gains meaning on the battlefield; if we can institutionalise solidarity and harmony in society, this is no less than jihad. An individual or faction cannot simply present a different prescription for the country based on personal preference; because running the country requires a unified decision and collective obedience.
